label: end-of-episode ramp (last ~5 trials), at D1 and S2 D2 steps
explanation: Episode-clock unit. It fires only in episode trials 90-99 (100% of activation mass; 2 of 11549 active steps fall before trial 90), and only when the value head is low (value < 5.22 holds on 100% of active steps), i.e. as the episode ends. It turns on gradually: coverage and magnitude grow with ep_trial, so the last few trials carry the largest activations (the top activation quartile is 97% covered by ep_trial >= 95). Within those trials it prefers D1 (71% of mass, more when the previous trial was rewarded: 58% of mass has in_rew = 1) and D2 when S2 is reached. It NEVER fires at D2 when S1 is shown and is weak at GO. Trial content (choice, transition, reward pattern, stay/switch, good state) barely modulates it. ep_trial >= 90 alone gets recall 1.0 but precision 0.11, because the unit is off on most late-episode steps, so the timing explains when the unit can fire but not which late steps it fires on. Recorded predicate: dev F1 0.54, mass recall 0.85. It uses no future variables; ep_trial is a clock the agent can integrate internally.
